title: Nexus Sovereignty Score
description: Scoring definition for measuring digital sovereignty across infrastructure stacks

data_residency.description: Physical and legal location of data storage, processing and operator jurisdiction

criteria.title: Primary data storage location
criteria.question: Where is primary operational data stored?

criteria.title: Operator legal jurisdiction
criteria.question: Under which legal jurisdiction is the operator of the primary service organised?

criteria.title: Backups, replicas and support access
criteria.question: Where are backups, replicas and privileged support access located?

vendor_independence.description: Replaceability of critical service dependencies and contractual exit readiness

criteria.title: Data export in open formats
criteria.question: Can data be exported in open, documented formats?

criteria.title: Self-hostable or replaceable
criteria.question: Can the service be self-hosted or replaced by another provider?

criteria.title: Contractual exit terms
criteria.question: Are termination, data return and deletion terms documented?

criteria.title: Single-vendor concentration
criteria.question: What share of critical services is concentrated with the same single vendor? (0.0 to 1.0)

dns_network_integrity.description: DNS resolution sovereignty and control of outbound network traffic

criteria.title: DNS resolver operator
criteria.question: Who operates the DNS resolvers used by the organisation?

criteria.title: Encrypted DNS
criteria.question: Is encrypted DNS in use for client and server resolution?

criteria.title: Outbound telemetry to non-EU endpoints
criteria.question: How much outbound telemetry is sent to non-EU endpoints?

criteria.title: Documented egress control
criteria.question: Is outbound egress control documented and enforced?

key_management.description: Cryptographic key custody, encryption coverage and provider access to plaintext

criteria.title: Encryption key custody
criteria.question: Who holds the encryption keys for primary data?

criteria.title: Encryption at rest and in transit
criteria.question: Is encryption applied at rest and in transit?

criteria.title: Key rotation and revocation
criteria.question: Are key rotation and revocation documented and tested?

criteria.title: Provider access to plaintext
criteria.question: Is the provider technically able to access plaintext?

ai_inference.description: Location and control of AI inference, retention and auditability

criteria.title: Inference location
criteria.question: Where does AI inference run?

criteria.title: Prompt and output retention for training
criteria.question: Are prompts or outputs retained or used for training by the provider?

criteria.title: Inference audit logging
criteria.question: Are inference events covered by audit logging?

regulatory_mapping.description: Documented mapping to GDPR, NIS2 and EU AI Act obligations where applicable

criteria.title: Legal basis for transfers outside the EU/EEA
criteria.question: Is a legal basis documented for every transfer outside the EU/EEA?

criteria.title: Records of processing and processor agreements
criteria.question: Are records of processing and processor agreements in place?

criteria.title: NIS2 risk management measures
criteria.question: If the organisation is in scope of NIS2, are risk management measures in place?

criteria.title: EU AI Act risk classification
criteria.question: Has EU AI Act risk classification been done for each AI system?

rules.not_applicable: A dimension or criterion marked not applicable is excluded and its weight is redistributed proportionally across the remaining ones. Criteria with a null level are treated as not applicable.
